course.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A large plate is fabricated from a steel alloy that has a plane strain fracture toughness of 82.4 (10) MPa √m. If, during service use, the plate is exposed to a tensile stress of 345 MPa, determine the minimum length of a surface crack that will lead to fracture. Assume a value of 1.0 for α.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
